shots.say: A spider like this flew to space and kept hunting.
Nefertiti spent a hundred days on the space station.
With no gravity, she still hunted her fruit flies.
Back on Earth, she retired to the Smithsonian.
Venomous? Yes. Big ones bite only if squeezed.
Subscribe. Next: the black widow's three hundred babies.
